prior_research.scope: Read without modification. Prior Thelma, Journey, Quest and road-use findings are retained as prior review, not newly georeferenced or silently corrected.

result: Quantum I and II county exhibits provide regional solar/reinvestment-zone context, but no reviewed exhibit identifies the co-located Google data-center parcel or supplies a usable absolute coordinate for it. The current operator page explicitly allows an alongside relationship, so the energy boundary cannot substitute for the data-center campus boundary.

physical_status_review.finding: The original June 4 release reports recent physical construction of the Google data center associated with Quantum. It does not name Thelma, Journey, Quest or Ranger and does not identify a parcel.
physical_status_review.date_guardrail: The original June 4 report remains the candidate observation; neither September retrieval nor the portfolio page's July 12 modification is used to refresh it. Recently began does not supply an exact start day.

scope_findings: Quantum I and II are energy facilities; the operator identifies a nearby Google data-center campus without naming its legal project or parcel.

The Quantum I and II tax agreements are explicitly for solar electricity generation. Their reinvestment-zone maps label solar areas, a substation, an operations-and-maintenance building and survey abstracts, not a Google data-center parcel.

The clearer Quantum II physical page 19 labels A00011 and A00124 within a broad mapped zone. Those abstract numbers also occur among the separate Journey and Quest legal leads in round36, respectively. Shared regional abstract labels do not establish exact parcel identity, spatial overlap or which Google campus is paired with Quantum.
The neighboring label on the clear map is A00414, not A94. No A94 match is claimed.

Scale bars, north arrows, roads and approximate energy-facility symbols do not supply a source-specific absolute coordinate or CRS for the data-center campus. None of these raster maps is digitized or anchored to an external geocode.
rejected_substitutes: Entire Quantum solar development or reinvestment-zone extent
Quantum substation or operations-and-maintenance building symbol
Haskell County Courthouse or Paint Creek School symbol
Relative Thelma, Journey or Quest survey reconstructed without an authoritative absolute anchor

successor_review.finding: The current operator portfolio body distinguishes energy operations beginning in June 2026 from the Google data center's recent construction. The page's status card still says In Construction, so the card is not treated as a precise data-center lifecycle statement.
successor_review.cutoff_guardrail: This undated current body is contextual only. No claim is made that all its text was present on the July 12 metadata modification date or by August 20.
successor_review.reason: A campus-specific successor review cannot be certified while the observed Quantum-linked data center remains unbound to a named legal parcel. Solar operation is not data-center completion.
